steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
A title is required to save and later find the draft.
Configure the draft as an eRFX RFQ project.
Apply the first available RFQ template so line items and the sheet can be configured.
Add the required draft line item.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Save the eRFX project as the draft required by the scenario.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify that the newly saved draft appears in the Drafts list.
Verify the event is still a draft and was not published.
Open the draft's attachment upload window.
Verify that the attachment upload window opened before the missing large-file action.

args.need: provide the 25 MB large_document.pdf, upload it in the open attachment window, click Save, and record the application's response

steps.note: The required 25 MB file is not an available upload fixture, so tester assistance is needed for the actual size-limit check.
Check that the screen remains usable and shows no crash or raw server error after the tester's upload attempt.
